text: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
script:
Here is a script based on the concept of Divine Purpose:

Hook: "God's plan is always working for you."

Context: "In Romans 8:28, Paul reminds us that God's goodness is at work in every situation."

Application: "Even when life gets tough, know His purpose is to bring good out of it."

Call to action: "Trust Him and watch His plans unfold."
